mutations.name: the CSP lets the page reach any host
mutations.expect: FAIL connect-src gains exactly those three

mutations.name: the page opens on the developer view, not plain words
mutations.expect: FAIL one switch, three views in order

mutations.name: a step is missing for a reader that runs no script
mutations.expect: FAIL a reader that runs no script still reads every step

mutations.name: the page is headed a bare Demo

Object.freeze({ query: 'Circle', ticker: 'CRCL' }),
  Object.freeze({ query: 'Tesla', ticker: 'TSLA' }),

  Object.freeze({ query: 'Circle', ticker: 'CRCL' }),
